title: The Words — Sc056: Darwin performs on a ladder, nose-to-nose with the T-Rex (178 frames)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: The scale-gag wide shot, built as a composite: a photorealistic T-Rex and the whole crowd exist only as the embedded layout/reference video, and the Flash production animates just five puppets against it. Darwin's entire ladder performance - meditating, preening, balancing, singing, all nose-to-nose with the dinosaur - is the reusable master symbol 'DRW_marche + lente' placed on two 'dwn' layers, while the four classmate reactors stay off or invisible for two-thirds of the shot and pop to full presence only for the final third, so the eye stays on the small fish performing at the giant's face. Lesson: when the environment and the giant are somebody else's render, your file's job is timing and eyelines, not redrawing their work.
notes: Like Sc061, this scene's frame is dominated by its 'layout mov' DOMVideoInstance: the photorealistic T-Rex, the ladder, the foreground crowd (a banana classmate, a one-eyed robot, a winged eyeball at top right) and the washed hallway all render from the reference video at low saturation/alpha - none of them are Flash puppets in this file, and none are named in it.

The finished Flash animation is Darwin plus four classmates. Darwin's act - two 'dwn' layers both placing the master symbol 'DRW_marche + lente' (426 kf) - has him performing on the ladder top in front of the T-Rex's face: cross-legged calm (f23), standing tall and smug (f45), balancing with arms out (f67), crouched singing (f89-112).

Tobias, Masami, Carrie and Ocho (each on a named layer) only reach full opacity in the last third (f134-178): Tobias huge and laughing in the foreground, Masami smiling at lower left, Carrie annoyed at upper right, Ocho dropping in on a thread at upper left (his layer holds 5 keyframes vs 1 for the others).
